source: Phase-3 DP-dogfood TEST profile. Recipe v1.0 with the day-log format knobs rule-bent to the product path's cadence: 60 s segments grouped 5-per-block, i.e. 1-min description records rendered into 5-min blocks. TEST-ONLY: it forks recipe_id (as any knob change must), so nothing trained under it is comparable to a v1.0 artifact, and it is not a publish candidate.
note: Every TRAINING knob is byte-identical to consolidation-v1.0 (48x amplification, 15% deny-then-correct, LoRA r128/a256 CPT 3ep, 30% replay from amp). Only corpus.segment_seconds (10 -> 60) and corpus.block_segments (12 -> 5) differ, which is a day-log FORMAT change, not a training change: it is what lets build_daylog bucket one 1-min caption per segment and group five of them into the 5-minute block the 5-min parity baseline used. Blocks stay ~5 minutes wide; only what fills them changes (5x1-min descriptions instead of 1x5-min), which is the one variable Phase 3 measures.
